claims.sourceText: CIA reading room document CIA-RDP80B01676R000700150004-7, 25 October 1961, https://archive.org/details/cia-readingroom-document-cia-rdp80b01676r000700150004-7
claims.text: A second, earlier instance of the office runs the other way. On 25 October 1961 the Director of Central Intelligence wrote to 'The Honorable Glenn T. Seaborg, Chairman, Atomic Energy Commission', thanking him for his impressions of a conference in Vienna and saying 'I am showing your good report to a few of our interested people.' It is signed 'Allen W. Dulles, Director'.
